with open("schedule.ini", "r", encoding="utf-8") as original:
    config = original.read()
    with open("schedule.ini", "w", encoding="utf-8") as replacement:
        replacement.write(config.replace("delay=30", "delay=05"))

with open("events.log", "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
    mirror = stream
    mirror.write("Δ\n")
    stream.write("done\n")

with open("labels.cfg", "r+", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as patch:
    patch.read(5)
    boundary = patch.tell()
    patch.seek(boundary)
    patch.write("new")

with open("./notes/./todo.txt", "r+", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as note:
    note.write("done")

with open("species.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source_file:
    species = source_file.read()
with open("card.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as card:
    card.write("<" + species + ">\n")

with open("signals.txt", "r+", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as document:
    signals = document.read()
    document.seek(0)
    document.write(signals.replace("go", "GO", 1))
